qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Global branch network and enterprise MSP relationships provide scale, but customer switching barriers are minimal with widespread multi-sourcing. Pricing power above wage inflation is absent as markups face constant commoditization. Return on invested capital deteriorated to 9.0% in 2024 (down from 11.0% in 2022 and 10.8% in 2023), failing the 12% proof-of-moat hurdle. Akkodis integration has underperformed.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (Moat & Pricing Power, REJECT). World #2 staffing firm operates in a highly commoditized, cyclical industry with negligible customer switching costs and negative pricing power. Capital efficiency fails the 12% Munger hurdle, with ROIC deteriorating from 11.0% in 2022 to 9.0% in 2024 following the dilutive Akkodis acquisition.
qualitative.evidence: ROIC fails the 12% hurdle across the cycle: FY2021 20.3% (post-COVID volume spike), FY2022 11.0%, FY2023 10.8%, FY2024 9.0% (operating profit before one-offs / invested capital), with GAAP after-tax ROIC below 8%. Operating margins are wafer-thin (3-4% EBITA). High customer multi-sourcing and vulnerability to AI/automation in clerical recruitment preclude defensible pricing power.
